people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
translations.bsb: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
translations.kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
translations.asv: This is now the third time that Jesus was manifested to the disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
